title: 3-candle doji reversal (engulf-doji-engulf) + grid add
entry_long: candle ID2=doji (body<upper wick and body<lower wick), candle ID1=bullish with body<=100pip, candle ID3=bearish -> buy first order, SL=candle ID2 low, no TP
entry_short: candle ID2=doji, candle ID1=bearish body<=100pip, candle ID3=bullish -> sell first order, SL=candle ID2 high, no TP
exit: first order has SL at doji high/low, no TP; grid-add orders have no SL/TP; whole basket cut-loss at -$10 (close_money)
buildon_idea: already money-capped via $10 basket cut-loss; add explicit max-order count cap and test linear vs log lot law on the grid adds; flat-lot PF test first
novelty_note: 3-candle doji reversal entry signal is a distinctive filter, common grid-add money-management otherwise

title: 7-EMA stacked alignment (forecasting) trend entry
entry_long: EMA1>EMA2>EMA3>EMA4>EMA5>EMA6>EMA7 fully stacked descending-period order, distance(EMA1,EMA7)<=1000pip -> buy, no SL/TP
entry_short: EMA1<EMA2<...<EMA7 fully stacked ascending-period order, distance<=1000pip -> sell, no SL/TP
exit: no SL, no TP, trailing stop 100pip/step5
buildon_idea: single-order-per-side, no grid/martingale as shown; buildon = add SL, or convert stacked-EMA signal into a filter for a capped grid-add system
novelty_note: 7-EMA full stack alignment is a fairly rare/strict trend filter vs typical 2-3 EMA crosses

title: RSI overbought/oversold reversal + opposite pending hedge + grid
entry_long: RSI(candle ID1)>=90 and candle ID1 bullish -> buy 0.01 SL100/TP150; simultaneously place pending sell-stop at candle ID1 low; if buy runs, add buy every 100pip (grid)
entry_short: RSI(candle ID1)<=10 and candle ID1 bearish -> sell 0.01 SL100/TP150; simultaneously place pending buy-stop at candle ID1 high; if sell runs, add sell every 100pip (grid)
exit: first order SL100/TP150; grid-add orders no SL/TP, managed by trailing stop 200pip/step5 once >=2 orders on a side
buildon_idea: add a max-order or lot cap on the grid-add leg; flat-lot PF check on grid adds; try log-lot law instead of fixed-add
novelty_note: opposite-side pending order placed at same time as the initial contrarian RSI entry (anticipating reversal) is a distinctive idea from a student suggestion

title: Custom-indicator import tutorial (Micro1360 Dynamic MA cross) + grid add
entry_long: custom indicator buffer0 (red) crosses above buffer1 (blue) between candle ID2 and ID1 -> buy 0.01, no SL/TP
entry_short: custom indicator buffer0 crosses below buffer1 between candle ID2 and ID1 -> sell 0.01, no SL/TP
exit: no SL/TP on entries; grid-add every 15pip on adverse move; hard cut via max-order count = 30 orders closes basket
buildon_idea: already order-count capped at 30; also admin/tooling content on importing external indicators into FX DMA (input/output buffer mapping) worth cataloging separately from the strategy
novelty_note: demonstrates importing a 3rd-party custom indicator (not a stock one) as the entry signal; also teaches the FX DMA custom-indicator import workflow

title: ZigZag breakout (structure break) with dynamic buy/sell lines + grid
entry_long: price closes above dynamic drawn 'Line_buy' object (set at ZigZag swing high, 20-candle lookback) -> buy 0.01, SL100, no TP; delete line after entry
entry_short: price closes below dynamic drawn 'Line_sell' object (set at ZigZag swing low) -> sell 0.01, SL100, no TP; delete line after entry
exit: first order SL100 only; grid-add every 50pip on adverse move (no SL/TP on adds); trailing stop 100pip/step10 once >=2 orders on a side
buildon_idea: add explicit max-order/lot cap to the grid-add leg; author notes this is a simplified rework of an earlier harder-to-understand breakout EA (#108), good base to extend with other exit systems
novelty_note: uses chart-drawn horizontal line objects (auto-generated at swing points) as the breakout trigger instead of pure indicator-value comparison; simplified redo of a prior example

title: Grid strategy with dynamic average-price TP synchronization (volume-capped)
indicators: price-action grid, no signal indicator (mode B/S toggle only)
entry_long: mode_B=true -> open buy every 100pip grid distance, fixed 0.01 lot, volume_upper_limit set to prevent lot-jump; no SL/TP; TP of whole basket dynamically Modify'd to average_price_B + 50pip
entry_short: mode_S=true -> open sell every 100pip grid distance, fixed 0.01 lot, volume_upper_limit capped; TP dynamically Modify'd to average_price_S - 50pip
exit: basket TP recalculated to breakeven+50pip via average-price formula each add; hard cut-loss at -30% of balance closes both sides
escalation_cap: volume_upper_limit per order + -30% balance basket cut-loss
buildon_idea: already volume-capped and %-balance cut-loss capped; core reusable technique = the average-price/breakeven TP-modify formula, applicable to any grid EA
novelty_note: teaches the general-purpose average-price (breakeven) calculation + auto-repositioning TP technique, explicitly meant to be reused across other EAs

title: Grid trading strategy with dynamic TP-to-average-price sync (trend-mode toggle)
indicators: price-action grid, no signal indicator (mode B/S toggle, recommend trend-following single side)
entry_long: mode_buy=true -> open buy every 100pip grid distance, fixed 0.01 lot, no SL/TP; TP of all buy orders Modify'd to average_price_buy + 50pip
entry_short: mode_sell=true -> open sell every 100pip grid distance, fixed 0.01 lot, no SL/TP; TP Modify'd to average_price_sell - 50pip
exit: basket TP recalculated to breakeven+50pip on each add; hard cut-loss at -30% of balance closes both sides and resets
escalation_cap: -30% balance basket cut-loss (no per-order lot cap)
buildon_idea: author explicitly recommends trend-following single-side use (buy-only in uptrend) for higher efficiency; add per-order lot/volume cap; reusable average-price TP-modify technique for other EAs
novelty_note: same average-price/breakeven TP-modify technique as the companion 126 video, demonstrated with single-side trend-following recommendation and live XAUUSD backtest

title: Dynamic Grid Zone with hedging escape (band +/-1000pip, 3% trigger)
entry_long: mode_B=true and price between dynamic upper/lower band lines (initial band = current price +/-1000pip) -> buy every 100pip grid inside band, 0.01 lot, TP100pip, no SL, volume_upper_limit capped
entry_short: mode_S=true and price inside band -> sell every 100pip grid inside band, 0.01 lot, TP100pip, no SL, volume_upper_limit capped
exit: in-band orders TP100pip each; if price breaks band and floating loss > 3% of balance -> open 1 hedge order sized 2x the trapped opposite-side lots (SL at band line, no TP); basket closes on +$5 profit and band re-centers; alt Cut-Loss-Mode closes basket outright at 3% loss instead of hedging
escalation_cap: volume_upper_limit per grid order + hedge capped at 1 shot (counter-locked) sized 2x trapped lots + 3%-balance trigger
buildon_idea: already has hedge-size logic and a mutually-exclusive cut-loss alternative mode; note author says the 2000pip band is too narrow, widen pip_level; the single-shot 2x hedge is itself capped (counter blocks repeat hedges) but if hedge SL is hit repeatedly the band re-centers without hard total-loss ceiling — verify with flat-lot/no-hedge test first
novelty_note: dynamic price-band (not fixed) that re-centers itself after basket close, plus a single capped counter-hedge as the band-break escape valve, is a distinctive combination

title: Dynamic Grid Zone and Hedging strategy (band +/-1000pip, 10% trigger)
entry_long: mode_buy=true and price between dynamic upper/lower band lines (band = current price +/-1000pip via pip_level) -> buy every 100pip grid inside band, 0.01 lot, TP100pip, no SL
entry_short: mode_sell=true and price inside band -> sell every 100pip grid inside band, 0.01 lot, TP100pip, no SL
exit: in-band orders TP100pip each; if price breaks band and floating loss > 10% of balance -> open 1 hedge order (counter-locked, single shot) sized 2x trapped opposite-side lots with SL at band line, no TP; basket closes on +$5 profit and band re-centers; alt Cut-Loss-Mode closes basket outright at 10% loss instead of hedging (mutually exclusive with hedge mode)
escalation_cap: single-shot counter-locked hedge sized 2x trapped lots + 10%-balance trigger; Cut-Loss-Mode alt caps total loss at 10% balance
buildon_idea: near-duplicate of the companion 127 video with 10% trigger instead of 3% and Every-tick 1-month backtest shown (100%+ return, 32.6% relative DD); test both 3% vs 10% trigger thresholds against each other and against symbols other than XAUUSD
novelty_note: same dynamic-band + single-shot capped hedge design as the sister video, different trigger threshold and live backtest numbers shown

title: Dynamic grid distance and lot size (doubling martingale) on candle-rejection entry
indicators: candle wick/body ratio filter (rejection candle, min candle size 100pip)
entry_long: mode_buy=true and (prior candle bearish with lower-wick>=40% of >=100pip candle_size [rejection], OR prior candle bullish with wick<=20% of >=100pip candle_size) -> buy 0.01 first order, no SL/TP; on adverse move each subsequent add doubles both lot size (L*2) and grid distance (60->120->240pip...)
entry_short: mode_sell=true and mirrored rejection/momentum candle condition -> sell 0.01 first order, no SL/TP; adds double lot and grid distance same as buy side
exit: no SL/TP on any order; basket closes on +$5 combined profit, then resets; author recommends restricting to one direction matching the visible trend for efficiency
escalation_cap: none stated (lot and distance both double uncapped)
buildon_idea: modified from an earlier example (#89); add a hard lot/step cap (e.g. stop doubling after N adds) or switch to linear-add; flat-lot PF test to isolate whether the rejection-candle entry itself has edge before judging the martingale scaling
novelty_note: doubles both the grid spacing AND the lot size together each add (most grid EAs in this batch only double the spacing or only the lot, not both) - a genuinely uncapped double-martingale structure
